name: Remote Transmitter → Transmit Panasonic
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions/#all-actions) sends a Panasonic infrared remote code to a remote transmitter.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The 16-bit address to send the command to, see dumper output for more details.

config_entries.label: Transmitter ID
config_entries.description: The remote transmitter to send the remote code with. Defaults to the first one defined in the configuration.

config_entries.label: Address 2
config_entries.description: The extra 8-bit address byte of a 56-bit code, see dumper output for more details. Only allowed with `nbits: 56`. Defaults to `0`.

config_entries.label: Carrier Frequency
config_entries.description: Set a frequency to send the signal with for infrared signals. Defaults to `35000Hz`.

config_entries.label: Nbits
config_entries.description: The number of bits of the remote code, `48` or `56`. Defaults to `48`.

config_entries.label: Repeat
config_entries.description: Defines the number of times the code is repeated when transmitted. By default, codes are sent only once.
